_comment: Care-data metafield definitions the theme reads (namespace: custom). Identical to the development store's definitions, so products exported from it import cleanly into a fresh store. Created by setup/setup-store.mjs, or by hand in Settings → Custom data. Choice lists must stay identical to the plant-finder quiz option values.

product.name: Latin name
product.description: Shown under the title when the title doesn't already contain it.

product.name: Difficulty (1 easy – 5 expert)
product.description: 1–2 = Easy, 3 = Intermediate, 4–5 = Expert. Drives the difficulty meter, filters and quiz.

product.name: Dormancy required
product.description: Shows the winter-dormancy notice on the product page in season.

product.name: Care guide
product.description: Long-form care notes; expandable at the bottom of the care card.

collection.name: Care guide link
collection.description: Path or URL shown under the collection title, e.g. /blogs/care-guides/venus-flytrap-care

article.name: Plants in this guide
article.description: Adds a 'Plants in this guide' product row under the article.
